summary.summary: Robert called to schedule a roofer to inspect and repair an issue on a rental property owned by his mother-in-law after a large rainstorm in November caused drywall to cave in inside the garage. He said an insurance company/adjuster inspected the roof and identified a problem in a “dead valley” area where the tile sections meet and advised it needed to be fixed. The representative collected the service address in Mesa, confirmed property details (tile roof, single-story, no HOA, not gated, no solar), gathered Robert’s contact information and the legal owner’s (Marilyn Warwick) name and phone number, and explained what to expect during the 1–2 hour inspection appointment. The call concluded with an inspection/visit scheduled for Friday between 1–3 PM, which worked for Robert (preferred after 10 AM).
key_points: Customer reported drywall caving in inside the garage after a big rainstorm in November; insurance inspection indicated a “dead valley” area on the tile roof needs repair.
